headline: Woodside Energy Targets Four Bass Strait Wells with 200 PJ Gas Potential
summary: Woodside Energy identified an opportunity to drill four development wells in Australia's Bass Strait holding an estimated 200 petajoules of gas potential.
why: Undertaking offshore gas development wells helps energy producers maintain domestic supply commitments and replenish hydrocarbon reserves.

impacts.name: Woodside Energy
impacts.why: New hydrocarbon development opportunities expand asset portfolios and future production potential.
